purpose: Ship a verifiable, self-contained slice of the Coffee stack (Control, UI, Community wiring) so forks and mirrors can prove they’re built on the same core bricks.
whoItsFor: Maintainers shipping a Coffee-based site or mirror
Contributors who want a clear “what this build is” reference
whoItsNotFor: Production auth or legal compliance (this page is informational)
End users who only need the app — send them to the splash / homescreen instead
requirements: Static host or dev server that serves JSON (fetch to distro-config.json)
coffee-control.js + coffee-ui.js paths intact relative to this file
